text:
🇲🇽🌎 <u>US SHARE OF MEXICO'S FDI DROPS TO 38.8% — DIVERSIFICATION ACCELERATES</u>

El Economista reports US share of foreign investment in Mexico fell to 38.8% in 2025, below the five-year average of 42.3%. In 15 states, the US is no longer the top investor — Canada leads in SLP and Veracruz, Japan in Tamaulipas, France in Puebla, Netherlands in Estado de México.

Total FDI still hit a record $40.871 billion in 2025 and $23.591 billion in Q1 2026 alone. Mexico isn't losing investment — it's gaining it from everywhere while reducing dependency on a single country.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>91% OF MEXICANS WOULD NOT VOTE PRI — DE LAS HERAS POLL</u>

De las Heras Demotecnia, June 2026 National Survey: 9 out of 10 Mexicans say they would NOT vote for the PRI. The party that ruled Mexico for 71 years now polls at 9% — dead even with PAN. Morena dominates at 44%.

The numbers tell the story of a party that sold Mexico to neoliberalism for seven decades and got its answer at the ballot box. 91% rejection isn't a slump. It's a verdict.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SINALOA: 11 ARRESTED, 6 DRUG LABS DISMANTLED, $6.3M HIT TO CARTELS</u>

Federal forces arrested 11 across Sinaloa including regional leader Iván "N." Six drug production sites dismantled in Culiacán and Cosalá — 5,490 liters of chemical precursors, 250 kg of materials, an organic synthesis reactor, and 7 kg of opium gum seized.

A Barrett rifle, 43 long weapons, 7 IEDs, and 49 blasting caps also confiscated. Authorities estimate 110 million pesos in direct economic damage to criminal organizations from a single coordinated operation.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM HITS 71% APPROVAL — BEATS AMLO BY 1 POINT</u>

De las Heras Demotecnia, June 2026: Claudia Sheinbaum at 71% favorable opinion, 7.2 out of 10 approval rating — one point above López Obrador. Morena at 47% party identification. PRI and PAN tied at 9% each.

"They've paid for a tremendous campaign against me," Sheinbaum said. "Whoever bets on Mexico doing poorly always loses."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SCJN BLOCKS MINISTER FROM SALINAS PLIEGO MINING CASE — UNANIMOUS VOTE</u>

The Supreme Court unanimously declared Minister María Estela Ríos González ineligible in two amparos filed by Desarrollos Zapal — Ricardo Salinas Pliego's mining company seeking 500 hectares in Baja California Sur for an open-pit gold mine.

Minister Loretta Ortiz argued Ríos had signed the original matter at Sedatu before reaching the bench. The Court agreed: conflict of interest, no exceptions. Not even for the oligarch's lawyers.

🇲🇽⚓ <u>MEXICO'S NAVY STRENGTHENS 103-PORT SYSTEM — 272M TONS OF CARGO</u>

SEMAR just published the numbers: Mexico's National Port System — 103 ports, 15 maritime terminals — moved 272.6 million tons of cargo and 9.37 million TEU containers last year. 19,750 ships served.

The Navy designates the port system as Mexico's "Second Maritime Interest" — under direct state administration, not private hands. That's what sovereignty looks like when it isn't theoretical.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>INEGI Q1 DATA: AGRICULTURE +0.6%, INDUSTRY -0.3% — 4T SOVEREIGNTY MODEL OUTPERFORMS MAQUILA EXPORT MODEL</u>

INEGI's Q1 2026 Global Labor Productivity Index (reported by El Economista): primary sector — agriculture, livestock, fishing — advanced 0.6%, while secondary sector (manufacturing, construction, mining, including the maquila export base) fell 0.3%. Tertiary sector flat.

Year-on-year, total productivity still grew 0.1%.

The 4T's food-sovereignty push — Sembrando Vida, fertilizer subsidies, Segalmex price floors, public corn purchases — is moving the needle in the campo. The neoliberal export model — built to feed US supply chains and now squeezed by Trump's tariffs — is the drag.

The transformation is in the soil, not in the maquila.

🥊🇲🇽 <u>FANNY ALEGRÍA UNIFIES THREE WORLD TITLES — MEXICO'S FIRST UNIFIED MINIMUMWEIGHT CHAMP</u>

Estefany "Fanny" Alegría dismantled Argentina's Evelyn Bermúdez 99-91, 99-91, 100-90 — and walked out with the WBC, WBA, and IBF minimumweight belts in a single fight.

Three world titles in one night.

She's now Mexico's 4th unified world champion in history — and the first ever in the minimumweight division. Next target: the WBO belt held by Lourdes "Pequeña Lulú" Juárez to become undisputed.

Mexican women's boxing keeps producing world #1s. Quietly, without sponsors, without the Saúl Álvarez circus. Just work.

🇲🇽🚆 <u>274,000 HOMES UNDER CONSTRUCTION — 4T BUILDS FOR WORKERS WHO EARN UNDER 2 MIN. WAGES</u>

Vivienda para el Bienestar: 274,000 homes already going up, plus 604,000 more contracted and ready to break ground. Total beneficiaries projected: about 7 million people.

Sheinbaum: "Nunca en la historia se había hecho un programa para familias que ganan menos de dos salarios mínimos" — never before has a Mexican program targeted families earning under two minimum wages.

52% of Infonavit beneficiaries are women. First 50,000 homes deliver before year-end. Sexennial target: 1.8 million homes.

Parallel transfers: 579,000 home-improvement credits, 293,000 deeds and loan cancellations, 5.1 million people benefited from credit restructuring.

For 36 years neoliberalism handed housing to Infonavit-backed real estate cartels. This is what reversal looks like.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>5,140 SOLAR ROOFS HIT BAJA CALIFORNIA — 44,160 MW CLEAN POWER, BILLS CUT UP TO 85%</u>

Sener just completed 5,140 photovoltaic systems across Mexicali and San Felipe under "Techos Solares para el Bienestar." Total output: 44,160 megawatts of clean electricity per year. Emissions avoided: 19,486 metric tons of CO2 equivalent.

For households in one of the hottest corners of Mexico, the bill drops are real: up to 85% off in summer, 45% in winter, 60% on average.

Phase 2 launches July with ~5,000 more panels, expanding into Hermosillo, Sonora. Run jointly by Sener, the state of Baja California, and CFE.

State-led energy sovereignty — built for working-class households, not for corporate solar farms exporting power across the border.
